Multiple murder cases involving spouses reported across India

Several Indian media outlets have reported on multiple murder cases involving spouses. In one incident, a man allegedly murdered his wife with a pistol and hid the body in a bathroom, with the case revealed after three months of marriage. Another report details a wife confessing to murdering her husband, with one outlet quoting her as saying she didn't know how many boyfriends she had. Elsewhere, a wife allegedly conspired with her lover to kill her husband, burying the body near the Maharashtra border. Other cases include a husband allegedly murdering his wife and burying the body in a river, a wife hiring contract killers for her husband's murder, and a husband found hanging after a dispute with his wife.
